protocol_findings.impact: If any skill in NR_skill has id >= sks.Length (e.g., >= max(512, num + 100)), the binary stream position becomes misaligned, causing all subsequent skills to read garbage bytes or throw EOFException, and id 1111 can overwrite sks[num - 1].
protocol_findings.root_cause: In readSkill(), when num3 < 0 or num3 >= sks.Length, the if-block (line 1888) skips reading effectHappenOnMob, numEff, skillStand, and skillfly bytes instead of consuming them from DataInputStream. Also line 1884 remaps num3 == 1111 to (short)(num - 1) without collision protection.
protocol_findings.title: Stream desync in readSkill() when skill ID exceeds sks array bounds

protocol_findings.impact: Stream desync if a 1-byte array is sent (1 byte left unread in Message stream), or OutOfMemoryException/OverflowException on corrupted negative/huge int lengths.
protocol_findings.root_cause: readByteArray(Message) silently skips reading when `num <= 1` (`if (num > 1)`), leaving 1 byte in the stream when `num == 1`; readByteArray(myReader) allocates `new sbyte[num]` with no bounds validation on `num`.
protocol_findings.title: NinjaUtil.readByteArray stream desync on len==1 and unchecked array allocation

protocol_findings.impact: Clan icon IDs >= 128 overflow to negative sbyte values when creating or updating a clan icon; request mode in TabClanIcon is dead code.
protocol_findings.root_cause: TabClanIcon.perform casts ClanImage.ID to sbyte before calling Service.gI().getClan; when isRequest is true, paintPeans() is empty and perform() fetches item into an unused local without bounds check on select.
protocol_findings.title: TabClanIcon casts icon ID to sbyte and has unfinished request-item handling

protocol_findings.impact: Item removal via REFRESH_ITEM leaves stale item objects with quantity <= 0 in inventory arrays; out-of-range slot/type or null slot throws NullReferenceException/IndexOutOfRangeException and aborts packet handling.
protocol_findings.root_cause: In case 100 (REFRESH_ITEM), b31 (0=body, 1=bag) and b32 (slot) are used without bounds or null checks on item2, and lines 459-462 set the local variable item2 = null instead of clearing Char.myCharz().arrItemBody[b32] or arrItemBag[b32]. Line 453 also checks num45 != -1 after readUnsignedByte() which never returns -1 (same dead check at lines 897 and 1146).
protocol_findings.title: REFRESH_ITEM (opcode 100) nulls local ref instead of inventory slot and lacks bounds/null checks

protocol_findings.impact: Packets referencing characters, Mabu bosses, NPCs, or mobs not currently present in the client map crash mid-read and are swallowed by catch(Exception), dropping the packet and leaving partial state.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Unchecked GameScr.findCharInMap, findNPCInMap, and findMobInMap results and unchecked (Mabu) casts in opcodes 31, 51, 52, -122, and -124. Additionally opcode -124 reads mobId into signed sbyte b9, breaking mob IDs >= 128.
protocol_findings.title: Missing null/type checks on map entity lookups in Controller2 packet handlers

protocol_findings.impact: Any code using NetworkOpcodes.LOGOUT, UPDATE_HP, UPDATE_MP, UPDATE_EXP, TASK_UPDATE, or NPC_CHAT will send/match completely wrong protocol commands (e.g. DIALOG_MESSAGE, MAXSTAMINA, STAMINA, BIG_MESSAGE).
protocol_findings.root_cause: NetworkOpcodes defines mismatched sbyte values compared to Cmd.cs (LOGOUT=-26 vs 0; UPDATE_HP=6 vs 5; UPDATE_MP=-69 vs MAXSTAMINA; UPDATE_EXP=-68 vs STAMINA; TASK_UPDATE=-70 vs 43; NPC_CHAT=32 vs 124). Controller2 ignores both and hardcodes numeric literals.
protocol_findings.title: NetworkOpcodes.cs contains multiple wrong opcode values colliding with Cmd.cs

protocol_findings.impact: Truncated/malformed packets can spawn phantom effects, trigger negative array size exceptions, or cause silent protocol desyncs with zero diagnostic logs.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Signed sbyte/short lengths (b19, b20, num40, b) are used directly for array allocation or indexing arrItemShop[b] without bounds checks. Opcode 113 still calls EffecMn.addEff after catching read errors. Sub-handlers readLuckyRound, readInfoRada, readInfoEffChar, and readActionBoss use empty catch(Exception) blocks.
protocol_findings.title: Unvalidated stream lengths and silent exception swallowing in Controller2 sub-handlers

protocol_findings.impact: Potential infinite loop / OOM freeze on malformed or EOF packet if myReader returns 0/empty string instead of throwing, or silent truncation on genuine stream errors.
protocol_findings.root_cause: requestItemPlayer (L96-100) and case 33 OPEN_UI_MENU (L3203-3207) use `while (true)` relying on an Exception at EOF instead of checking `msg.reader().available() > 0` (unlike L269 and L2635). Case -4 (L3769) and case 54 (L3833) also loop up to 10 times relying on EOF catch.
protocol_findings.title: Infinite while(true) EOF-by-exception loops in requestItemPlayer and case 33

protocol_findings.impact: Deferred map loading after receiving the requested map template fails or reads a disposed/nulled stream.
protocol_findings.root_cause: In case -24 (MAP_INFO), when TileMap.loadMapFromResource throws, the catch block requests the map template and stores `messWait = msg;` before breaking out, but the `finally` block at L4634-4640 unconditionally calls `msg.cleanup()` immediately at the end of `onMessage`.
protocol_findings.title: messWait saved in case -24 is immediately cleaned up in finally block

protocol_findings.impact: NullReferenceException / IndexOutOfRangeException aborts onMessage packet processing when entities despawn, bags/mobs exceed index, or unexpected indices arrive.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Multiple handlers dereference `GameScr.findMobInMap`, `GameScr.findCharInMap`, `Char.mobMe`, `Char.clan`, `GameScr.vMob.elementAt(readByte/readUnsignedByte)`, `arrItemBag[sbyte]`, `arrItemBox[sbyte]`, and `@char.attMobs[0]` without null or array bounds checks.
protocol_findings.title: Widespread missing null and bounds checks on map entities, mobMe, and inventory arrays

protocol_findings.impact: Values overflow/truncate if server sends mapID >= 256, bag icon >= 256, pickup currency delta > 32767, or bag/box/mob indices >= 128.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Inconsistent primitive widths across opcodes: `mapID` read as unsigned byte in case -24 (L3675); `bag` read as unsigned byte in -80/-64 vs short in -99 (L1119); bag/box/mob indices read as signed `sbyte` (`readByte()`); pickup currency delta read as `readShort()` in case -20 (L3371); xu/yen/power deltas read as `readInt()` in -1/-2/95/-3 vs `readLong()` in case 6.
protocol_findings.title: Narrow or signed protocol integer widths for mapID, bag, indices, and currency deltas

protocol_findings.impact: IndexOutOfRangeException crash when serializing a single byte/bool at exact buffer boundary (e.g., byte 2048).
protocol_findings.root_cause: writeSByte calls checkLenght(0), and checkLenght checks `posWrite + ltemp > lenght`. When posWrite == lenght (e.g., 2048), `2048 + 0 > 2048` evaluates false, then `buffer[posWrite++] = value` writes out of bounds.
protocol_findings.title: Off-by-one capacity check in myWriter.writeSByte causes IndexOutOfRangeException at buffer boundary

protocol_findings.impact: Silent packet corruption/desync on truncated payloads instead of failing fast; read(ref sbyte[]) never signals EOF.
protocol_findings.root_cause: readSByte/readShort/readInt/readLong silently clamp posRead to buffer.Length and return 0 on EOF; readString truncates num to remaining bytes; read(ref sbyte[]) checks `if (posRead > buffer.Length) return -1;` which is unreachable because readSByte clamps posRead == buffer.Length.
protocol_findings.title: myReader silently returns 0/truncated data on EOF and read(ref sbyte[]) EOF check is dead code

protocol_findings.impact: NullReferenceException crash in Controller.messageSubCommand case 35 when player has no mobFocus and another char shares cTypePk; wrong char lookup skips actual players in map.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Loop iterates `i` from 0 to vCharInMap.size() but calls `GameScr.findCharInMap(i)` (lookup by charID instead of elementAt(i)), and accesses `Char.myCharz().mobFocus.isMobMe` without checking `mobFocus != null`.
protocol_findings.title: Wrong char lookup and missing mobFocus null check in messageSubCommand case 35 (PK type update)

protocol_findings.impact: Potential NullReferenceException or IndexOutOfRangeException crashing packet handling on malformed or racy server updates.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Missing null/bounds checks on Char.myCharz().charFocus (Controller.cs:5751), GameCanvas.panel.myMember index (ClanPacketHandler.cs:132), Char.myCharz().clan (ClanPacketHandler.cs:271), itemMap.template (ItemPacketHandler.cs:50), and arrItemBag[bagIndex] (ItemPacketHandler.cs:145); also signed readByte() used for array allocations in multiple places (Controller.cs:4645,5982, MapMovementPacketHandler.cs:86, TaskNpcPacketHandler.cs:89).
protocol_findings.title: Missing null/bounds checks and signed-byte array lengths in packet handlers

protocol_findings.impact: Stream desynchronization and corrupted inventory/skill state if any error occurs while reading body items or truncated cooldown packets.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Controller.cs:5897 swallows exceptions in arrItemBody loop and continues reading arrItemBag/arrItemBox from misaligned offset. CombatPacketHandler.cs:130 loops `while (available() > 0)` reading 6 bytes per entry without checking `available() >= 6`.
protocol_findings.title: Exception swallowing mid-stream in arrItemBody and missing 6-byte availability guard in SKILL_COOLDOWN

protocol_findings.impact: writeString corrupts non-ASCII (Vietnamese) characters by truncating UTF-16 chars to sbyte; readString rejects strings >32767 bytes due to signed short length.
protocol_findings.root_cause: myWriter.writeString casts each char to sbyte (dropping high byte) instead of UTF-8 encoding; writeUTF/readString use signed short length.
protocol_findings.title: writeString truncates UTF-16 chars and writeUTF/readString use signed short length

protocol_findings.impact: TCP stream framing permanently desyncs on partial socket reads, corrupting the XOR keystream and dropping/garbling all subsequent packets; `readMessage2` can also NRE if called before key exchange or allocate huge buffers.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `dis.ReadBytes(num)` is assumed to always return `num` bytes (no read-loop until `num` bytes received), and `readMessage2` unconditionally calls `readKey()` without checking `getKeyComplete` or validating `num4` upper bounds.
protocol_findings.title: Partial TCP Read & Unchecked readMessage2 Framing Desync

protocol_findings.impact: Opcode `66` (`getImgByName`) received over `Session_ME2` is parsed with a 2-byte length instead of 3-byte `readMessage2`, corrupting the TCP stream.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2.MessageCollector.readMessage()` checks `b == -32 || b == -66 || b == 11 || b == -67 || b == -74 || b == -87` and omits `|| b == 66` present in `Session_ME.cs:202`.
protocol_findings.title: Missing Extended-Length Opcode 66 in Session_ME2.readMessage

protocol_findings.impact: Sending any message with non-null payload before `getKeyComplete` silently drops all payload bytes on the wire while writing an unencrypted little-endian `ushort` length, corrupting framing.
protocol_findings.root_cause: In `doSendMessage`, the `if (getKeyComplete)` loop writing `data` bytes has no `else` branch for `!getKeyComplete`, and unencrypted length uses `dos.Write((ushort)num)` (little-endian) vs big-endian when encrypted.
protocol_findings.title: Missing Unencrypted Payload Write & Endianness Mismatch in doSendMessage

protocol_findings.impact: Session XOR keystream breaks with `OverflowException` or `IndexOutOfRangeException` if server sends a key of length >= 128 bytes.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Key length is read via `readSByte()`, and `curR`/`curW` are `sbyte` indices that wrap negative at 128 (`curR = (sbyte)(num + 1)`).
protocol_findings.title: Signed sbyte Overflow in XOR Key Length and curR/curW Indices

protocol_findings.impact: `Session_ME2` defaults to `isMainSession = true`, which can trigger main-session disconnect/fail handlers and infinite `GameCanvas.connect2()` recursion on secondary socket events.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2` was copy-pasted from `Session_ME` with `public static bool isMainSession = true;`.
protocol_findings.title: Session_ME2 Defaults isMainSession to true

protocol_findings.impact: Opcode collisions and `sbyte` truncation risk misrouted handlers or silent slot/ID corruption when inventory/map/template indices exceed 127.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `gotoPlayer` and `requestPlayerInfo` share cmd `18`; `sendOptHat` and `sendCT_ready` share cmd `24`; `skill_not_focus` and `new_skill_not_focus` share cmd `-45`; numerous item/UI indices and IDs are written via `writeByte()`, and `useItem` uses `-1` sentinel for `template`.
protocol_findings.title: Overloaded Opcodes (18, 24, -45) and Signed Byte Slot/ID Truncation in Service.cs

protocol_findings.impact: If Service.gI().sendMessAllPlayerInMap throws before msg.cleanup(), the Message(-45) buffer is leaked.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `Message msg = new Message(-45); ... msg.cleanup();` is not wrapped in `try-with-resources` or `finally`.
protocol_findings.title: GoldenFrieza.prepareBom() does not clean up Message(-45) in a finally block

protocol_findings.impact: If playerAtt is null or sendMessage throws IOException, msg.cleanup() is skipped (potential ByteBuf leak) or NPE occurs during leaveMap().
protocol_findings.root_cause: Message(-6) is created without try-finally cleanup() and playerAtt.sendMessage(msg) is called without null check on playerAtt.
protocol_findings.title: TrainingBoss.leaveMap() Message(-6) lacks try-finally cleanup and playerAtt null guard

protocol_findings.impact: If write/send throws IOException, the Netty-backed Message buffer in sendTypePK is never released.
protocol_findings.root_cause: msg.cleanup() is placed inside the try block instead of a finally block.
protocol_findings.title: Missing finally cleanup for Message in DeathOrAliveArenaService.sendTypePK

protocol_findings.impact: Potential double-cleanup of Netty ByteBuf in topList, leaked Message on exception in sendTypePK, and missed SuperRankBuilder.dispose() on exception in topList.
protocol_findings.root_cause: topList calls msg.cleanup() in try (line 119) and again in finally (line 128), while dispose()/clear() are only in try; sendTypePK calls msg.cleanup() only in try without a finally block.
protocol_findings.title: Double Message.cleanup() in SuperRankService.topList and missing finally cleanup in sendTypePK

protocol_findings.impact: Once shop_ky_gui.id exceeds 32767, clients receive truncated/negative item IDs and cannot buy/claim items; older/newer clients or >127 items in tab 4 suffer EOFException/stream desync.
protocol_findings.root_cause: openShopKyGui writes 32-bit int itk.id via writeShort(itk.id), writes list sizes via writeByte without clamping (>127 overflows), skips null items after writing header count, and openShopKyGui(Player) omits the version>=222 check for quantity and adds an extra newItem byte compared to openShopKyGui(Player, byte, int).
protocol_findings.title: Consign shop protocol ID truncation (writeShort on int id), byte count overflow, and version desync in openShopKyGui

protocol_findings.impact: Client receives mismatched item count vs written slot bytes on REOPEN_TAB_COMBINE (-81) or truncated OPEN_TAB_COMBINE when npcChose is null, causing EOFException/UI corruption.
protocol_findings.root_cause: reOpenItemCombine writes itemsCombine.size() as the byte count header, then skips null or consumed items that are no longer in itemsBag without adjusting the count. openTabCombine omits npcChose.tempId if null.
protocol_findings.title: Protocol stream desync in CombineService.reOpenItemCombine and openTabCombine

protocol_findings.impact: Guaranteed binary stream desync / EOFException / crash on all online clients when Namek Shenron (Porunga) is summoned or dismissed.
protocol_findings.root_cause: SummonDragonNamek.activeShenron writes opcode -83 with mapId, bgId, zoneId, then UTF(pl.name) — omitting the 4-byte int(pl.id) that SummonDragon.activeShenron writes before UTF. Also neither activeShenron cleans up Message(-83) in a finally block, leaking Netty buffers.
protocol_findings.title: Opcode -83 Stream Desync and Message Leak in SummonDragonNamek & SummonDragon

protocol_findings.impact: Trade lock packet (-86 sub 6) causes stream desync when two trading players use client versions across the 222 threshold; Maintenance during LOCK_TRADE/ACCEPT causes NPE when trade is null.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Trade.lockTran checks sender's session.version < 222 instead of receiver's session.version < 222 before sending quantity as byte vs int. TransactionService checks Maintenance.isRunning and calls trade.cancelTrade() before null-checking trade.
protocol_findings.title: Trade Lock Version Check Mismatch & NullPointerException on Maintenance

protocol_findings.impact: Buffer/memory leak on exception in openShopType3; potential byte truncation if tab/item/option counts > 127 or option IDs >= 256.
protocol_findings.root_cause: openShopType3 calls `msg.cleanup()` inside the try block (line 362) with no finally block, unlike openShopType0/1/4/8. Shop open methods also serialize list sizes and optionTemplate.id with `writeByte`, which wraps if option ID >= 256 or item count > 127.
protocol_findings.title: Missing finally msg.cleanup() in openShopType3 and writeByte truncation risks

protocol_findings.impact: If Netty EventLoop flushes the -27 key packet and receives the client's next encrypted packet before the Virtual Thread executes session.setSentKey(true), NroPacketDecoder treats the encrypted packet as plaintext and corrupts/disconnects the session. Also if big commands (-32,-66,-74,11,-67,-87,66) are sent before sentKey is true, NroPacketEncoder still XORs the 3 size bytes and advances curW, desynchronizing the stream.
protocol_findings.root_cause: KeyHandler.sendKey invokes async channel.writeAndFlush via session.doSendMessage and sets sentKey=true afterward without ChannelFuture listener synchronization; NroPacketEncoder applies writeKey to 3-byte sizes unconditionally without checking shouldEncrypt.
protocol_findings.title: XOR handshake race condition and unconditional size-byte encryption in Netty pipeline

protocol_findings.impact: If item option count, map count, NPC count, or mob count exceeds 255 (or mob id > 255), writeByte silently truncates the count, causing client deserialization mismatch/crash on login or reload.
protocol_findings.root_cause: ItemData.createCacheItemOption and DataGame.updateMap / requestMobTemplate serialize collection sizes and mob IDs as 1-byte writeByte().
protocol_findings.title: 1-byte writeByte truncation on template counts and mob IDs in DataGame/ItemData

protocol_findings.impact: Version <= 214 gold display cap (Integer.MAX_VALUE) never triggers, potentially overflowing gold display on older clients.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Inventory.player is never initialized or assigned anywhere in Inventory, so `player != null` in getGoldDisplay() is always false.
protocol_findings.title: Inventory.player field is never assigned, making getGoldDisplay() version check dead code

protocol_findings.impact: If player IDs exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE, IDMark.playerTradeId truncates and mismatches; also fusionEffect casts long master.id to int.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Character.id is long, while IDMark.playerTradeId is typed as int (unlike long idPlayThachDau/killCharId/idEnemy).
protocol_findings.title: IDMark.playerTradeId uses int instead of long Character.id

protocol_findings.impact: If status==20 requests switching from a Type-2 skill (Tri Thuong) to another skill, it executes Tri Thuong first and skips switching; Type-4 skills consume MP and trigger cooldown with no combat effect.
protocol_findings.root_cause: useSkill evaluates skillSelect.template.type == 2 at line 110 before checking status == 20 skillId switching at line 172; useNewSkillNotFocus (type 4) had special cases removed (line 226) and only calls affterUseSkill.
protocol_findings.title: useSkill checks Type-2 buff before status=20 skill switch and Type-4 skills are no-ops with MP/CD cost

protocol_findings.impact: Truncating long param in sendTNSM (-3) and target count in newSkillNotFocus (-45) can overflow client-displayed TNSM or drop/corrupt target lists when >127 targets exist.
protocol_findings.root_cause: sendTNSM casts long param to int (writeInt((int) param)); newSkillNotFocus casts playersTaget.size() + mobsTaget.size() to signed byte (line 339), causing negative num if >127. Also useSkill (line 86) silently ignores IOException when reading status==20 packet fields.
protocol_findings.title: Integer/byte truncation and silent IOException swallow in packet writers/readers

protocol_findings.impact: Client receives a mismatched player count vs written player entries when a player enters/leaves the zone mid-call, causing stream desync/EOF on the client.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `sendMabuAttackSkill()` writes `player.zone.getNotBosses().size()` as a byte, then invokes `player.zone.getNotBosses()` a second time in the for-each loop without snapshotting or locking.
protocol_findings.title: Stream count/body desync in Service.sendMabuAttackSkill()

protocol_findings.impact: Client disconnects or throws EOF/AIOOBE on malformed platform strings, out-of-bounds `cFlag`, or `pl.id > 127` in `charDie`; `changePassword()` mutates in-memory session password even if DB update fails.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `charDie()` writes `(int) pl.id` with `writeByte`; `sendFlagPlayerToMe()` indexes `flagIconId[pl.cFlag]` unchecked; `setClientType()` accesses `arrPlatform[1]` unchecked; `addEffectChar()` never calls `msg.cleanup()`; `changePassword()` sets `session.pp = newPass` before `executeUpdate`.
protocol_findings.title: Multiple protocol/state edge-case bugs in Service.java

protocol_findings.impact: High risk of opcode misrouting or developer confusion when adding/modifying packet handlers.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Top-level command IDs and sub-command IDs (NOT_LOGIN, NOT_MAP, SUB_COMMAND) are mixed in one flat class with many colliding byte values (e.g., 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 13, 14, 16-18, 20-23, 35, 38, 40, 41, 50, 62-66).
protocol_findings.title: Flat Cmd_message class mixes top-level and sub-command opcodes with widespread byte collisions

protocol_findings.impact: If Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE.size() exceeds 127, writeByte overflows to a negative value on the client; in Clan.sendMessageClan, exceptions before cleanup() leak the Message.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Achievement count written as signed byte; Clan.sendMessageClan lacks finally block for msg.cleanup() and silently swallows exceptions.
protocol_findings.title: Protocol byte size truncation in AchievementService and missing finally cleanup in Clan.sendMessageClan

protocol_findings.impact: Potential buffer/resource leak if `sendMessage` or `sendMessAllPlayerInMap` throws an exception before `msg.cleanup()`.
protocol_findings.root_cause: `msg.cleanup()` is placed inside `try` instead of `finally` in `MobMe`, `BaseMenu`, `MabuEgg`, `MagicTree`, `MobEffectSkill`, `Mob.sendMobMaxHp`, and `Zone`.

protocol_findings.impact: Potential client stream desync on combine/craft animation (-81) when 3 or 5 bag indices are written after count byte 2.
protocol_findings.root_cause: Message(-81) writes subcommand 1 and item count byte 2, but then writes 5 bag indices in CayThong and 3 bag indices in HungVuong.
